examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a Text Timer with Start, Pause, and Reset Buttons
examples.description:
This example demonstrates the basic usage of the TextTimer component, setting the timer display format using the format attribute.
Users can start, pause, and reset the timer by clicking the start, pause, and reset buttons.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Text Shadow Style
examples.description: In this example, the textShadow property is used to set the text shadow style of the timer.

examples.title: Example 3: Configuring the Custom Content Area
examples.description: This example showcases two simple TextTimer components set against a light gray background. Once the timers are activated, they display the time progression in real-time. When the countdown timer starts, the background turns black; when the count-up timer starts, the background turns gray.

examples.title: Example 4: Enabling the Timer to Start Immediately After Creation
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to start the TextTimer immediately after it is created.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Text Style
examples.description: This example uses the fontColor, fontSize, fontStyle, fontWeight and fontFamily attributes to display text in different styles.
